must_have: a mechanic with a one-sentence explanation
meaningful mastery in the first minute
brief.creative_direction: cute at first glance, mechanically surprising underneath; prove one excellent desktop interaction first, then branch successful lineages into mobile, online, and WebXR adaptations

concept.title: Prism Duet
concept.hook: Two mirrored unicorn echoes emit rainbow waves; stand in constructive interference to charge your horn, but the arena shatters where waves cancel.
concept.core_mechanic: You steer two mirrored unicorns whose hoofbeats emit circular color waves. Where same-color waves overlap, tiles charge and score; where opposite colors meet, tiles crack and fall away. Your score multiplier is a physical prism shard floating in the arena; enemies can shove it into dead zones, destroying it. Defeat enemies by detonating charged tiles beneath them.
concept.player_goal: Survive the duel, protect your prism shard, and clear all enemies before the arena collapses.
concept.controls: Mouse moves both echoes symmetrically; left-click detonates charged tiles; right-click flips wave polarity.
core_loop: Position echoes to overlap waves and charge tiles
Detonate charged tiles to defeat enemies
Herd enemies away from your prism shard
Rebuild footing as cracked tiles fall
escalation: Enemies begin dragging the prism shard
Third wave color adds partial-cancellation zones
Final duel on a fully eroding floor
concept.visual_grammar: Procedural canvas: interference fringes rendered as additive rainbow gradients over a tile grid; cracks and polarity flips read instantly.
concept.audio_grammar: WebAudio oscillators per wave color; constructive zones hum in harmony, dissonance swells as tiles near collapse.
concept.byte_hypothesis: Tile grid + analytic wave superposition + two mirrored agents fits in ~9KB with no assets.
risks: Interference readability may fail at high tile density
Mirrored dual control may confuse in the first ten seconds
Shard physics could feel unfair without clear telegraphs
